integration_scope: Explicit public web/RSS/GitHub/YouTube metadata and English captions, adapted from Agent-Reach channel architecture; pinned yt-dlp, no upstream installer or account access.
source_commit_resolution: Build receipt binds final commit and all payload files; this source metadata does not assert approval, signature or activation.
exclusion_reason: Unchanged host-specific legacy scripts remain only in trusted signed baseline runtime.
acceptance_limits: No general web search provider or JavaScript browser is added. Existing public research providers remain available.
Public English YouTube captions only, subject to upstream availability. No account cookies, downloaded video, transcription service, browser plugins, or remote code components.
Web/feed reader supports bounded public UTF-8 HTTPS sources. Redirects and private network addresses are refused.
New Core reach/read tool retains external-network approval. The existing browser scoped-grant feature supports only research/public and project/tests; Public reach has its own explicit owner UI mode.
No physical audio, drive removal/reinsertion or second-host tests were performed.
